story_text:
We’ve all been there: checking the temperature and still wondering if the food is really ready. Food doesn’t cook evenly, where you measure matters, and a single temperature reading can still leave you guessing.
Wireless thermometers promised the freedom to step away from the heat. But freedom isn’t very useful if you can’t count on it. Dropped connections, limited range, and a battery that constantly needs charging can leave you right back where you started.
That’s why we created PocketChef.
A smarter wireless cooking thermometer designed around the things that matter most during the cook: accurate temperature information, dependable connectivity, and battery life that keeps going.
PocketChef gives you the freedom of wireless cooking without losing track of what matters.
PocketChef. Know the temperature. Know when it’s ready.
## A number still leaves questions.
Wireless thermometers make it easier to monitor your food. But they can still leave you with questions.
Set a target in the app, then follow the cook from your phone. One probe. One app. A clear next step.
1. Insert the probe into your food before cooking.
2. Select your food, cooking appliance, and preferred doneness in the app.
3. PocketChef tracks your cook and alerts you when to remove your food from heat and when it’s ready.
4. Serve it up and enjoy good food with great company.
5 + 1 Sensors. More of the cook is covered.
5 Food Sensors: Measure temperature at multiple points along the probe. 1 Ambient Sensor: Tracks the surrounding cooking temperature.
6 sensing points give you more temperature information than relying on one internal measurement point alone.
Stay connected to the cook from farther away, with up to 200 ft from probe to base and 400 ft from base to phone. More range means more freedom to prep, relax, or step inside while the cook continues.
Monitor longer cooks without constantly thinking about the next charge. PocketChef provides up to 57 hours of battery life.
Stay focused on the food—not the battery icon.
## Precision
Detailed readings help you track small temperature changes as your food approaches the target.
More precise readings help you remove food at the right moment for the doneness you want.
## High-Heat Cooking
High heat shouldn’t mean losing track of the cook. From open-flame grilling to high-temperature searing, PocketChef is designed to remain in place as the heat intensifies—so you can follow the food’s progress without repeatedly removing or repositioning the probe.
## Made for the way you cook
Grill. Roast. Smoke. Air Fry. Sear.
Whether it’s a quick weeknight meal or a long, slow cook, PocketChef is made to go wherever the menu takes you.
Grill, sear, roast, air fry, smoke, or go low and slow.
From a quick weeknight steak to an all-day brisket, PocketChef keeps you connected with live temperature progress and a clear Ready alert.
Built with stainless steel, the PocketChef probe is designed for real cooking and easy cleanup. When the cook is finished, simply rinse it under running water or place it in the dishwasher.
STAINLESS STEEL • IPX8 WATERPROOF • DISHWASHER SAFE
PocketChef didn’t stop at the drawing board. We put the probe, sensors, wireless connection, battery, and high-heat performance through engineering testing to verify that the product performs the way we designed it to.
TEMPERATURE TESTINGVerifying sensor accuracy and performance across the probe.
EXTREME TEMPERATURE TESTINGValidating probe performance under demanding cooking temperatures.
Because when you’re trusting PocketChef with the cook, we want you to trust the numbers behind it, too. Follow the cook with confidence—from the first reading to the moment it’s ready.
risks: Bringing hardware to market involves manufacturing, certification, supply chain, and logistics variables. Our approach is simple: manage those risks carefully and transparently without compromising quality. Manufacturing & Quality Control: Scaling production requires precision and consistency. We work with experienced manufacturing partners and conduct rigorous quality checks before units ship. Supply Chain & Components: Material and electronic component lead times can fluctuate. We actively manage sourcing and production planning to minimize potential disruptions. Testing & Certification: PocketChef is a high-precision wireless cooking device subject to safety and wireless certification requirements. Testing and regulatory review can occasionally take longer than anticipated. Shipping & Logistics: International freight, customs, and regional delivery networks can create delays outside our direct control. We work with established logistics partners to keep fulfillment moving as efficiently as possible. Our Commitment We will never rush production at the expense of quality. If unforeseen challenges affect our timeline, we will communicate openly and promptly, keeping you informed about our progress and your expected delivery.

faq.a: Insert the PocketChef probe into your food, set your target temperature in the app, and start cooking. Pocket Chef monitors the cook and sends temperature updates and alerts to your phone, so you know when it’s time to act.

faq.q: How many temperature sensors does Pocket Chef have?
faq.a: PocketChef uses 6 NTC sensors: 5 food sensors positioned along the probe and 1 ambient sensor that monitors the surrounding cooking environment.

PocketChef provides up to 600 ft of total wireless range, including up to 200 ft from the probe to the charging base and 400 ft from the base to your phone. Actual range can vary depending on walls, appliances, and other environmental conditions.

faq.q: How long does the battery last?
faq.a: PocketChef provides up to 57 hours of battery life, making it suitable for everything from quick meals to longer cooks.
PocketChef provides temperature readings with 0.5°F precision.

faq.q: What can I cook with PocketChef?
faq.a: PocketChef is designed for a wide variety of cooking methods, including grilling, roasting, smoking, air frying, and searing. Use it for foods ranging from steaks and chicken to roasts and long, slow-smoked cuts.
Yes. PocketChef is designed for high-heat cooking environments up to 1,000°F, making Pocket Chef suitable for applications including grilling and searing.
Yes. PocketChef is designed to be waterproof for easy cleaning.

faq.q: What can I do with the PocketChef app?
faq.a: The PocketChef app guides you through the cook from start to finish. Select what you’re cooking and your preferred doneness or target temperature, monitor temperature and cooking progress in real time, view estimated cook time, and receive alerts when it’s time to act.

faq.q: What phones are compatible with the PocketChef app?
faq.a: The PocketChef app will be available for compatible iOS and Android smartphones. Specific operating system requirements will be provided before PocketChef begins shipping.

updates.text:
We've received several thoughtful questions about PocketChef's performance and design, and we'd like to share a few additional details with our supporters and followers.
## Real-Time Temperature Monitoring
PocketChef is designed for continuous real-time temperature monitoring throughout the cooking process. Rather than taking a single spot reading, PocketChef continuously tracks food temperature and updates the companion app, allowing you to monitor cooking progress without repeatedly opening the grill, smoker, oven, or air fryer.
